import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-55-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-55")
import w2_55_support as s  # noqa: E402

work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w2-55-probe-"))
api = s.Api(work / "api")
reg = s.register(
    s.entry("DEC-101", "The first beacon rule", "SUPERSEDED by DEC-102 · **Basis:** OWNER",
            s.tags(lands_in="none"), "The vermilion beacon clause applies to every harbour light."),
    s.entry("DEC-102", "The beacon rule, restated", "ACCEPTED · **Basis:** OWNER · **Supersedes:** DEC-101",
            s.tags(), "The vermilion beacon clause applies to every light and buoy."),
)
ticket = ("---\nid: HARB-0001\nstatus: open\ntype: task\ntitle: 'Beacon rules for the harbour'\n"
          "sources:\n- DEC-102\n---\n# HARB-0001\n\nBody.\n")
p = s.build_project(work / "repo", reg, {".tickets/HARB-0001.md": ticket})
api.build(p.root)
r = api.gov(p.root, "retrieve", "vermilion beacon clause")
print(r.returncode)
res = r.envelope.get("result", {})
print(json.dumps([(e["path"], e["start_line"], e["end_line"], e["id"]) for e in res.get("evidence", [])]))
print(json.dumps(res.get("merge")))
c = api.gov(p.root, "context", "HARB-0001")
print(c.returncode, c.stdout[:3000])
f = api.gov(p.root, "context", "--in-force")
print(f.returncode, f.stdout[:500], f.stderr[-500:])
print(work)
